Initial educational release of QuantChapter Monte Carlo Lab.

- Dependency-free uniform Monte Carlo integration with validated scalar inputs.
- Sample standard error and explicitly approximate normal confidence intervals.
- Prespecified convergence experiments with every seeded replication included.
- Offline square/sine CLI with versioned JSON and atomic no-overwrite output.
- Worked mathematical derivation, executed notebook, static reproducible figure,
  numerical/property tests, locked development tooling, and installed-wheel checks.

Python 3.11–3.14. MIT license. This release is not learner-piloted or certified.
See SECURITY.md and docs/api.md for callable trust, work limits, numerical
representation, random-stream, and confidence-interval assumptions.
